gloss: unhulled rice; rice in the husk

definitions.gloss: unhulled rice; rice in the husk; paddy
definitions.explanation: Rice grains that still have their outer husk on, as harvested from the plant before threshing and hulling.

examples.japanese: {籾|もみ}を{乾燥|かんそう}させる。
{収穫|しゅうかく}した{籾|もみ}を{倉庫|そうこ}に{保管|ほかん}する。
examples.english: We store the harvested unhulled rice in the warehouse.

examples.japanese: {籾|もみ}から{殻|から}を{取|と}り{除|のぞ}くと{玄米|げんまい}になる。
examples.english: When you remove the husk from unhulled rice, you get brown rice.

notes:
Rice as it comes off the plant, still wrapped in its hard outer husk. After drying, the husk is removed to make {玄米|げんまい} (brown rice), which is then polished into {白米|はくまい} (white rice).

RELATED WORDS:
- {籾殻|もみがら}: rice husk — the outer covering removed from the grain
- {玄米|げんまい}: brown rice — hulled but unpolished
- {稲|いね}: rice plant — the growing plant that produces {籾|もみ}
